sources.entry: Sentry | Error tracking and performance monitoring

summary.one_liner: Self-Hosted Sentry is a packaged deployment of the Sentry error tracking and performance monitoring platform, aimed at low-volume deployments and proofs-of-concept.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only states that this repository packages Sentry, described as feature-complete, for self-hosting. It is aimed at low-volume deployments and proofs-of-concept. The README points to external documentation for setup and usage, so the exact install steps, required resources, and configuration options are not included in the README text provided. The listing in the awesome-selfhost-docker list places it under the Development category as an error tracking and performance monitoring tool.
notable: Packages the full Sentry platform for self-hosting
Nightly build channel per the README title
Points to external documentation for setup
caveats: Intended for low-volume deployments and proofs-of-concept, not stated as production-scale
README is minimal and defers setup details to external documentation
Labeled as nightly, so builds may be unstable
keywords: self hosted alternative to hosted error tracking
